reason: The change releases only paired orphan claims for failed provider turns after durable tool, hook, child and approval checks. Six exact recovery regressions cover preserved failed-turn history, unsafe effects, mismatched goal claims, dangling turn and ToolCall approval references, reverse Approval.tool_call_id links, approved/edited approvals without settled calls, and failed or unknown continuation delivery; collection expects 44 cases across SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: Only the six named tests in test_runtime_orphan_recovery.py are selected. The rest of that module, all other Python suites, frontend/browser/native tests, production Core access, and live provider or Mac operations are excluded. PostgreSQL tests run against a disposable localhost-only PostgreSQL 16 container with tmpfs storage; no persistent database is used.
